nativeDialogBoundary.behavior: Parameter names appearing as cardinal plural selectors remain numeric until cardinal selection/formatting. Other string/number interpolations receive FSI/PDI at the native-dialog presentation boundary.
nativeDialogBoundary.callsite: BrowseSession passes filesToDownload.length as count and directory.name as directory. The count stays numeric; the opaque directory string is isolated.
